action.description: Create a branch or list branches.

from.description: The source branch to create from (default `main`).

name.description: The branch name to create (required for `create`).

workspace.description: The workspace whose lorestore the branch lives in.

BranchAction.description: The branch action: create a new branch or list the existing ones.

oneOf.description: Create a new branch at the source branch's head.
